newsitem.title: RUSSIA: NK Surgut 1996 profit 5.2 trillion roubles.
newsitem.headline: NK Surgut 1996 profit 5.2 trillion roubles.

text.p: Russia's vertically integrated oil company Surgut Holding (NK Surgutneftegaz) made a profit of 5.2 trillion roubles ($904 million) last year, the same profit as in 1995, the company president said on Saturday.

"In 1996 the company's subsidiaries made 5.2 trillion in profit, 5.0 trillion of which came from sales, and 200 billion from non-sale revenues," Vladimir Bogdanov said in a report to shareholders at their annual meeting.
Based on 1996 results, shareholders approved a dividend of 3,000 roubles for 1,000 rouble shares, the same dividend as in 1995.

As of the end of April 1997 the largest shareholder was ZAO Surgutfondinvest, which operates the non-government Surgutfondinvest, 40.1 percent; ZAO Neftinvest, 36.4 percent.
22.7 percent of the comany was owned by 30 enterprises and 7,500 invididuals. The state ownership is 0.9 percent.
The subsidiary AO Surgutneftegaz is one of Russia's largest oil producing companies and is located in Western Siberia.
